scope: Offline first-passage content comparison using unchanged Game modules; not production registration, Campaign save compatibility, human play or a balance ranking
stop: V0 retirement, player defeat, diagnostic or player action limit

support_card.name: 周囲への防御付与（試行）

placement: Replace the first N weak_B positions in ACT01 authored 12-card deck before its existing initial shuffle; initial_card_counts/catalogue updated in temporary content only

policy_rules.common: Use only current public state, legal choices and one-action predictions; heal when full printed recovery is useful or expiring with positive recovery; then exclude heal if any nonheal option exists; prefer attacks on V0, sorted by actual HP loss, posture gain, printed power, shorter remaining lifetime, card_id; fallback positive guard then shortest lifetime/cost/id. NPC policy unchanged.
policy_rules.progress: Use common priority; no extra guard preference ahead of attacks
policy_rules.guard_first: Before attacks, use a positive self-guard match only when no self_guard effect is active; use the same public action ordering otherwise
policy_rules.limits: Neither policy preserves a stance by refusing a legal attack, predicts NPC choices or optimizes multi-action routes; they are probes, not player style models

control_notes: Same attributes, amount and deck for 1-use and unlimited self effect; this isolates duration and does not rank sustained guard versus a higher-evasion dodge card
blank controls have kind none and no defense_grant, otherwise the same support-card values and positions; distinguish removal of weak attacks from the additional grants
Matched support ignores field amount modifiers under the existing declared support implementation; positive/negative support material scaling remains outside this numeric trial
No forced redraw, immediate regeneration, dedicated replenishment, passive defense, new enemy AI or extra economy
All inputs fixed before the batch; include every seed, defeat and censored run; do not select success cases
